justification: Loop control variable id is not validated against actual bitmap bounds, allowing potential out-of-bounds access if map->elements is maliciously set.
analysis: The function processes a bitmap of IP set elements and calls ip_set_ext_destroy on each active element. The loop iterates from 0 to map->elements without checking if map->elements is valid or comes from untrusted input. If map->elements is corrupted or maliciously set, it could cause out-of-bounds memory access when calling get_ext() or ip_set_ext_destroy(). There are no explicit bounds checks on the id variable against the actual allocated bitmap size.
